guardian.1.daily_greeting: Today's tide is the same for everyone. Ride it your own way.
guardian.1.defeat: You rode right past me. Well swum, friend.
guardian.1.greeting: Welcome, little one. Watch the tide, and let it guide your hands.
guardian.1.incomplete: The tide went out. It always comes back. Try again?
guardian.1.name: Mako
guardian.1.new_best: ...Your finest swim yet. I felt the whole sea move.
guardian.1.one_star: You rode the wave! The sea has more to teach you.
guardian.1.respect: You swim like one of us now.
guardian.1.three_star: Perfect rhythm. The sea is smiling.
guardian.1.title: Spirit of the Tides
guardian.1.trial_intro: Here comes my biggest wave. Show me the rhythm you've learned.
guardian.1.two_star: Lovely form. The current liked you.
guardian.10.daily_greeting: One mountain for everyone today. Pick your path and climb.
guardian.10.defeat: You passed me on my own mountain. Bravo!
guardian.10.greeting: Welcome to the mountains. Breathe slow and climb steady.
guardian.10.incomplete: The path got steep. Catch your breath and try again.
guardian.10.name: Wayra
guardian.10.new_best: ...Your best climb yet. What a view!
guardian.10.one_star: You reached the top! Next time, enjoy the view.
guardian.10.respect: You climb like one of the herd. Welcome to the heights.
guardian.10.three_star: Not one stone slipped. A perfect climb.
guardian.10.title: The Highland Friend
guardian.10.trial_intro: This is my highest peak. Show me how well you climb.
guardian.2.daily_greeting: The river runs the same for everyone today. Steady hands win.
guardian.2.defeat: My jaws closed on nothing. You were faster!
guardian.2.greeting: Welcome to the Nile. Take your time. A careful hand goes far here.
guardian.2.incomplete: The current won this time. Rest, then try again.
guardian.2.name: Sobek
guardian.2.new_best: ...The old river is impressed. So am I.
guardian.2.one_star: You crossed! Next time, aim a little truer.
guardian.2.respect: The Nile makes way for you. Safe travels, friend.
guardian.2.three_star: Flawless. Even the old stones are impressed.
guardian.2.title: The Nile Guardian
guardian.2.trial_intro: The river is rising. Keep your footing and cross to me.
guardian.2.two_star: A fine crossing. I saw that precision.
guardian.3.daily_greeting: Same snow for the whole pack today. Run your best line.
guardian.3.defeat: The storm breaks. The wolf steps aside. Lead on.
guardian.3.greeting: Welcome to the north. Keep the fire in your heart and stay close.
guardian.3.incomplete: The cold won this round. Warm up and run again.
guardian.3.name: Fenris
guardian.3.new_best: ...A new howl on the ice. It's yours.
guardian.3.one_star: You made it through the frost. Good start.
guardian.3.respect: The pack is proud of you. Run with us through the ice.
guardian.3.three_star: Not a flake touched you. A legend's run.
guardian.3.title: The Frost Wolf
guardian.3.trial_intro: The blizzard is here. Run through it with me.
guardian.3.two_star: Strong run. The ice held for you.
guardian.4.daily_greeting: One puzzle for every mind today. Enjoy working it out.
guardian.4.defeat: Checkmate, and elegantly played. I bow.
guardian.4.greeting: Welcome to the grove. Carve one steady strike at a time.
guardian.4.incomplete: Not solved yet. Look from a new angle and retry.
guardian.4.name: Noctua
guardian.4.new_best: ...Remarkable. I did not see that coming.
guardian.4.one_star: A pass! Now let's make it elegant.
guardian.4.respect: Knowledge and action, together at last. Well done.
guardian.4.three_star: Not a single flaw. I'm delighted.
guardian.4.title: The Marble Owl
guardian.4.trial_intro: You know the theory. Show me how you use it.
guardian.5.daily_greeting: The river flows the same for everyone today. Go steady.
guardian.5.defeat: The storm passes, and you're still standing. Bravo.
guardian.5.greeting: Welcome. Be patient like the river and you'll go far.
guardian.5.incomplete: The current carried you off. Plant your feet and try again.
guardian.5.name: Long
guardian.5.new_best: ...Your best yet. The dragon is delighted.
guardian.5.one_star: You held through the flood. Good!
guardian.5.respect: The dragon bows to your patience. Well earned.
guardian.5.three_star: Not even my torrent could shake you. Wonderful.
guardian.5.title: The Jade Dragon
guardian.5.trial_intro: The dragon wakes. Stay calm and stand your ground.
guardian.5.two_star: The river bends to your patience. Well done.
guardian.6.daily_greeting: One mosaic for every eye today. Find the pattern in your own time.
guardian.6.defeat: The pattern was you all along. Come through.
guardian.6.greeting: Welcome to my gate. Every tile has its place. Can you see it?
guardian.6.incomplete: The tiles scattered. Gather them and retry.
guardian.6.name: Lamassu
guardian.6.one_star: You found the pattern! Its beauty comes next.
guardian.6.respect: The gate stands open. You see what others miss.
guardian.6.three_star: Every tile in its place. A lovely mosaic.
guardian.6.title: The Gate Guardian
guardian.6.trial_intro: My gate opens for a sharp eye. Show me the pattern.
guardian.6.two_star: The mosaic takes shape in your hands.
guardian.7.daily_greeting: Same trick for everyone today. Let's see who spots it first.
guardian.7.defeat: Nine tails, all fooled. You win this round!
guardian.7.greeting: Catch me if you can! I play fair... mostly.
guardian.7.incomplete: Lost in my illusions? Find your way back and try again.
guardian.7.name: Kitsune
guardian.7.one_star: You slipped past my tricks. Just!
guardian.7.respect: You saw through every trick. I like a sharp eye.
guardian.7.three_star: Every illusion shattered. You're sharper than my claws.
guardian.7.title: The Spirit Fox
guardian.7.trial_intro: Nine tails, nine illusions. Can you see through them all?
guardian.7.two_star: Not bad. You kept your wits when the foxfire flickered.
guardian.8.daily_greeting: One canopy for everyone today. Find your own way through.
guardian.8.defeat: You flew past my brightest feathers. Well done!
guardian.8.greeting: Welcome! Clear whole rows and let the light in.
guardian.8.incomplete: The leaves hid the way this time. Try again?
guardian.8.name: K'uk'
guardian.8.new_best: ...Your best flight yet. I'll keep a feather for it.
guardian.8.one_star: You found the path! There's more to see.
guardian.8.respect: You fly like one of the flock now.
guardian.8.three_star: A perfect flight. The jungle is singing.
guardian.8.title: The Jade Feather
guardian.8.trial_intro: My feathers catch every light. Can you keep up with me?
guardian.8.two_star: Nicely flown. The canopy hums with you.
guardian.9.daily_greeting: The same savanna for everyone today. Walk it your own way.
guardian.9.greeting: Welcome to the plains, little one. I'll walk beside you.
guardian.9.incomplete: The grass grew tall this time. Try again?
guardian.9.name: Tembo
guardian.9.new_best: ...Your best yet. The whole herd will hear.
guardian.9.one_star: You made it across! The plains have more.
guardian.9.respect: The herd makes room for you now.
guardian.9.three_star: A flawless crossing. I'll never forget it.
guardian.9.title: The Gentle Giant
guardian.9.trial_intro: Here comes the herd. Keep your footing and match my stride.
guardian.9.two_star: Good, steady steps. The herd noticed.

lesson.stars.1: Three goals, three stars. Light all three and the level is yours.
lesson.stars.2: A bar fills over the whole run. A ring needs one single move.
